Dropped your phone in water? Do not put it in a bag of rice.
Small bits of rice can get inside and damage it.
Do not plug it in to charge while it is wet, either.
Wet pins in the port can corrode, and that damage can be permanent.
And no hair dryer, no heater, no compressed air.
Do not poke a cotton bud or a paper towel into the port.
Instead, unplug any cables, and wipe it dry with a soft cloth.
Tap it gently against your hand, port facing down, to shake the water out.
Then leave it somewhere dry, with a little air moving around it.
Give it at least thirty minutes before you try to charge it. It can take up to a day to dry.
So next time your phone takes a swim, leave the rice in the kitchen.
